title: AGENT BUS — THE LIVING DISTRICT
subtitle: 24 line-art production panels · action, perspective and camera continuity
status: Director’s working shot board. All 24 panels are illustrative staging studies; product visual implementation remains paused.
emotionalGoal: Hey, that looks cool. He keeps watching because the next moment is even more satisfying. It needs to slap.
primaryRule: Keep the accepted close, low-angle attract composition. Its background is the actual management district and its usual activity, seen from that camera.
referenceNote: 20 successive keyframes describe the 24-second attract loop. Four untimed P01 frames describe the later player-chosen management view. Lines, arrows and camera notes direct artists; these studies start no agents and report no live work.

cinematic.title: ATTRACT / LOW AND CLOSE
cinematic.note: The host and actual management district from a close, low camera. This framing continues throughout the repeating film.

management.title: PLAY / THREE-QUARTER OVERHEAD
management.note: Same district and facility positions. This reference is a later explicit player choice, outside the attract loop.

nonNegotiables: One district, two perspectives: the attract background and management view share the same world assets, facility positions and work state.
Keep something alive in the frame: gaze, hover, traffic or machinery. Give each large motion a readable cause and satisfying consequence.
The conversation is usable from the first frame. Typing, focus and partial speech never pause the loop. Enter or one completed, explicitly started utterance commits once.
The loop stays in its close cinematic language. The overhead management camera is a later player choice, never an automatic attract-loop ending.
Preserve the approved original host, slate/cyan/violet/copper/cream palette and layered dimensional buildings.
All storyboard activity is labelled DEMO. In production, actual work, results and movement consume the same scoped state; motion cannot manufacture completion.
All local 3D pictures, light, reflections and shadows render on hardware GPU. Unsupported hardware gets the preserved illustration.
No Help, FAQ, setup wizard or account wall interrupts the opening. Operational detail belongs behind the player's chosen controls.
No floating scoreboard, comic project card or replacement backdrop. The reveal is spatial and belongs to this district.
Use one identifiable copper/cyan packet, preserve visible custody, and show the cause before its consequence. Line art is sufficient for this production board.

beats.title: Already alive
beats.motion: Track the gaze, then the hand; carry the packet toward Research.
beats.mood: Instant cool. Tangible, inviting, playful confidence.
beats.meaning: We are already inside the place the player will manage. Recognizable facilities occupy their real positions in the background.
beats.transition: Match on the packet into the Research intake.
beats.interrupt: Typing or Speak is available immediately. A draft keeps the camera and city moving.
beats.copy: Let action and perspective carry the beat.
beats.sound: Planned direction: one warm power-on accent over a restrained rhythmic bed. The visual hook must work with sound muted.

panels.label: Track
panels.action: Host hovers in foreground; lenses follow a passing courier. One sealed packet rests in the hand.
panels.movement: Lens pan follows courier; hold the foreground host silhouette.
panels.subject: Host and one copper/cyan packet

panels.label: Notice
panels.action: Host turns both lenses toward the viewer; head tilts before the arm moves.
panels.movement: Small push in; eyes lead the pose.
panels.subject: Host and one copper/cyan packet

panels.label: Lift
panels.action: Gripper raises the SAME packet into view; copper tab and cyan seam establish its identity.
panels.movement: Tilt down just enough to keep hand and eyes in the composition.
panels.subject: Host and one copper/cyan packet

panels.label: Present
panels.action: Arm opens toward the Research intake; packet leads the eye into the district.
panels.movement: Follow the gesture; cut on the packet moving toward Research.
panels.subject: Host and one copper/cyan packet

beats.title: Follow the work
beats.motion: Follow one identifiable packet through custody changes; never create a duplicate.
beats.mood: Personality and anticipation. A character welcomes you into a living toy world.
beats.meaning: The host directs attention. Its personality gesture carries no work, provider or completion claim.
beats.transition: Cut on the Workshop latch closing; retain custody of the same packet.
beats.interrupt: The existing conversation stays in place. No greeting is required before participating.
beats.copy: Let action and perspective carry the beat.
beats.sound: Planned direction: paired mechanical clicks followed by a brief rising accent, synchronized to the joints.

panels.label: Catch
panels.action: Research tray receives the packet presented in S01D; host hand withdraws.
panels.movement: Match the packet position across the cut; keep travel left to right.
panels.subject: Research intake → Workshop dock

panels.label: Inspect
panels.action: Instrument hoop closes around the packet; scan passes across the copper tab.
panels.movement: Tighten to an insert; arrow marks the scan sweep.
panels.subject: Research intake → Workshop dock

panels.label: Carry
panels.action: Courier lifts the inspected packet from the tray and turns toward Workshop.
panels.movement: Track beside the courier; Research recedes behind it.
panels.subject: Research intake → Workshop dock

panels.label: Dock
panels.action: Workshop latch catches the packet; courier opens its empty grippers.
panels.movement: Stop with the packet at the same screen position; cut on latch closure.
panels.subject: Research intake → Workshop dock

beats.title: Make. Check. Repair.
beats.motion: Show anticipation, assembly, a visible fault, then repair and a second scan.
beats.mood: Momentum. Satisfying machinery, purposeful little characters, a bigger world opening up.
beats.meaning: Illustrative DEMO: assembly maps to saved edits; a named test finds a defect; repair and rerun precede the represented pass. The storyboard dispatches nothing.
beats.transition: Follow the same verified fixture to the Preview dock.
beats.interrupt: Drafting stays passive. A committed request branches into actual work without restarting the world.
beats.copy: Let action and perspective carry the beat.
beats.sound: Planned direction: short mechanical accents lock into a groove, leaving space for the reveal.

panels.label: Brace
panels.action: Two mechanical arms brace the docked packet; hinges take up their weight.
panels.movement: Low three-quarter close-up; arms frame the focal object.
panels.subject: Workshop arms → Verification Lab

panels.label: Assemble
panels.action: Hinged panels unfold into a dimensional project fixture; a raised collar leaves one visible gap.
panels.movement: Arc a little around the fixture; preserve the copper tab.
panels.subject: Workshop arms → Verification Lab

panels.label: Find the gap
panels.action: Courier carries that fixture into Verification; a scan ring stops at the raised collar.
panels.movement: Match-cut on the fixture; bracket the visible gap, not a floating failure card.
panels.subject: Workshop arms → Verification Lab

panels.label: Seat + rescan
panels.action: A service tool seats the collar. The ring scans again and completes its band.
panels.movement: Hold the same test angle so before/after is unmistakable.
panels.subject: Workshop arms → Verification Lab

beats.title: The world answers
beats.focus: Preview Gateway and the same built fixture
beats.motion: The gateway reveals a spatial result inside this district; attached controls act on it.
beats.mood: The grin. A toy-commercial payoff you want to try yourself.
beats.meaning: Illustrative DEMO: the pavilion represents a candidate-bound preview. This composition is production direction, not an implemented new demo or real provider result.
beats.transition: Keep the living project visible as the host looks back toward the viewer.
beats.interrupt: The prompt remains usable. No camera movement, effect or glass panel may intercept the player's input.
beats.copy: A dimensional result responds inside the world.
beats.sound: Planned direction: a satisfying reveal hit, tactile scoring accents and one color-change flourish.

panels.label: Receive
panels.action: Verified fixture arrives at the Preview dock; its copper tab remains visible.
panels.movement: Low tracking arrival; gateway stands behind the fixture.
panels.subject: Preview Gateway and the same built fixture

panels.label: Open
panels.action: Dock latches, struts lift, and gateway leaves pull apart in a mechanical chain.
panels.movement: Dolly back as the opening widens; arrows follow the leaf motion.
panels.subject: Preview Gateway and the same built fixture

panels.label: Reveal
panels.action: The built project unfolds as a dimensional kinetic pavilion within the gateway.
panels.movement: Low wide; pause for the silhouette and depth to read.
panels.subject: Preview Gateway and the same built fixture

panels.label: Respond
panels.action: A nearby hand presses the attached control; the pavilion vanes rotate in response.
panels.movement: Stay in the world; show hand, control and consequence in one composition.
panels.subject: Preview Gateway and the same built fixture

beats.title: Your turn
beats.focus: Host, living district and persistent input space
beats.motion: Return attention to the viewer while the district keeps breathing; match the loop seam.
beats.mood: Belonging and playful invitation. No obligation, homework or hurry.
beats.meaning: The player can type or speak over the trailer. An explicit commit makes a real owned project request; a draft alone does nothing to the work system.
beats.transition: No input: continue seamlessly into S01. Explicit input: keep this world and conversation while real work begins.
beats.interrupt: The intended sweet spot is partway through a second loop. Enter sends once; Shift+Enter keeps drafting; partial dictation never dispatches.
beats.sound: Planned direction: a brief melodic invitation that resolves into the opening rhythm; avoid an exhausting hard reset.

panels.label: Return
panels.action: Host looks from the moving pavilion back to the viewer.
panels.movement: Follow the gaze toward the original low camera.
panels.subject: Host, living district and persistent input space

panels.label: Invite
panels.action: Open gripper gestures toward the conversation area that has been available since frame one.
panels.movement: Small inviting lean; leave the input area clear.
panels.subject: Host, living district and persistent input space

panels.label: Breathe
panels.action: Host settles into a hover; courier traffic and a distant mechanism continue.
panels.movement: Hold the close framing; quiet motion remains visible.
panels.subject: Host, living district and persistent input space

panels.label: Loop match
panels.action: Host returns to the opening orientation as a courier enters the S01 travel path.
panels.movement: Match S01A framing, light and pose phase; no automatic overhead move.
panels.subject: Host, living district and persistent input space

beats.title: Choose your perspective
beats.duration: Player-selected branch · outside the attract loop
beats.motion: Only the explicit Your district choice changes camera. These four references are outside the loop.
beats.mood: The spectacle becomes ownership. The world they watched is the world they can use.
beats.meaning: Buildings and agent positions correspond to actual research reports, saved edits, named checks, review and candidate-bound previews. Selection inspects; explicit assignment starts work. Multiple projects keep separate state.
beats.transition: A later player-driven camera change, with recognizable geography throughout. Never insert this shot automatically into the repeating attract loop.
beats.interrupt: Every control remains keyboard-accessible. Dragging agents, CLI reports and GUI instructions share the same actual work state.
beats.sound: Planned direction: the same sound palette becomes quieter, responsive feedback during real work.

panels.label: Keep the state
panels.action: Current low camera holds the same host, project fixture and facility work state.
panels.movement: Record the starting pose before the player chooses a view.
panels.subject: Player-selected management view

panels.label: Choose
panels.action: Player explicitly chooses Your district; geography and project identity stay fixed.
panels.movement: A motivated camera lift begins only after that choice.
panels.subject: Player-selected management view

panels.label: Compare
panels.action: Intermediate angle retains recognizable Research, Workshop, Test and Preview relationships.
panels.movement: Continue the same arc; no replacement city or invented work state.
panels.subject: Player-selected management view

panels.label: Manage
panels.action: Camera settles at the familiar three-quarter overhead district view. Same work, direct control.
panels.movement: Orthographic [60,62,58] → [0,2,-2], span 68; keep selection stable.
panels.subject: Player-selected management view

reviewOrder: Can the action be followed without captions?
productionRules.agentHandoff: Name the shot ID, intended change, shared assets and camera, source of activity, fallback, and verification. Change the shared blueprint first when a decision affects several shots.
productionRules.implementationState: Current board replaces the earlier single-frame-per-shot treatment. The floating comic scoreboard direction is removed. Accepted host/world assets and earlier artifacts remain archived. Product management integration remains partial, paused and unqualified.
